nodes.text: You've been to Merra's shop. People come from her wall to my book, and they always stand just where you're standing. Yes. *Edwin's* page is here. Signed north in his own hand, the spring of the early wolves. No homecoming mark.

I'll tell you what the registry knows that the cape on her wall doesn't: his caravan made the Fork. He gave his place at the palisade to a tinsmith's family and stood the last watch outside the wall himself. The sergeant's report says the lamps never went out that night. _He kept them lit._

She knows the shape of it. She's never asked for the page, and I don't press. If she ever asks, the book is hers. Until then I read his name to the braziers each feast, and she keeps the cape clean. Between us he stays remembered. Thank you for asking.
Peace on his road, wherever it went. And on yours. Signed and marked, if I have any say in it.
